name: Мат (3)
description:
If you want to win a game of chess, you need good mating skills.

In this theme, the black king can be near all four edges of the board. That changes nothing for how you create checkmate.

Have a look at the example:

  • The white queen checks the king
  • The white king helps the white queen: he protects the queen.


What do you have to do?

Checkmate the king with the white queen. This can be done in a single move.

texts: Check the king and ensure it has no escape squares. That's checkmate!
